title: slugify leaves a trailing dash
source: S6 workflow suite, and the S28 parity runs — a real fix, made repeatedly by both engines
objective: slugify("Hello World!") returns "hello-world-" with a trailing dash. It should return "hello-world". Fix it and add a regression test.
note: Kept BECAUSE it is easy: a case every engine solves is the control that shows the harness itself works. It is excluded from the ranking by its difficulty, not by being absent.
